summary: From containerized AAP 2.5 on RHEL 9, upgrade to 2.6 on RHEL 9; for RHEL 10, back up and restore onto a fresh container 2.5 install on RHEL 10, then upgrade; or upgrade and migrate to OpenShift 2.6.
questions: How do I upgrade containerized AAP 2.5 to 2.6?
How do I move containerized AAP 2.5 to RHEL 10?
Can I migrate containerized AAP to OpenShift?
